// Generator for golden.json. Put in a dir with go.mod (module browsergolden), a copy of
// internal/browser/confirm.go and captcha.go's CaptchaInfo/consts/DetectCaptchaFromHTML (package main), then:
//   go run . tests/fixtures/browser/samples.json tests/fixtures/browser/golden.json
// Differential golden generator for src/browser (Rust port). Copies of internal/browser
// confirm.go and DetectCaptchaFromHTML live next to this file (package main).
// Usage: go run . <samples.json> <golden.json>
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"sort"
)

type samples struct {
	HTML       []string   `json:"html"`
	DomainSets [][]string `json:"domain_sets"`
	URLs       []string   `json:"urls"`
	Success    [][2]any   `json:"success"`
}

func main() {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var s samples
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &s); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	out := map[string]any{}
	var captcha []map[string]any
	for _, h := range s.HTML {
		c := DetectCaptchaFromHTML(h)
		captcha = append(captcha, map[string]any{"found": c.Found, "type": c.Type, "confidence": c.Confidence, "description": c.Description})
	}
	out["captcha"] = captcha

	var domains [][]map[string]any
	for _, set := range s.DomainSets {
		h := NewConfirmationHandler(set)
		var rows []map[string]any
		for _, u := range s.URLs {
			// Go map iteration is random: collect every domain a subdomain match can report.
			seen := map[string]bool{}
			var valid, isErr bool
			for i := 0; i < 200; i++ {
				ok, d, err := h.ValidateDomain(u)
				valid, isErr = ok, err != nil
				seen[d] = true
			}
			var ds []string
			for d := range seen {
				ds = append(ds, d)
			}
			sort.Strings(ds)
			rows = append(rows, map[string]any{"url": u, "valid": valid, "error": isErr, "domains": ds})
		}
		domains = append(domains, rows)
	}
	out["validate_domain"] = domains

	var success []map[string]any
	h := NewConfirmationHandler(nil)
	for _, p := range s.Success {
		code, body := int(p[0].(float64)), p[1].(string)
		ok := h.isSuccessResponse(code, body)
		st := h.ExtractConfirmationStatus(&ConfirmationResult{Success: ok, StatusCode: code, ResponseBody: body})
		success = append(success, map[string]any{"status": code, "body": body, "success": ok, "status_text": st})
	}
	out["success"] = success

	enc, _ := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[2], append(enc, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
